subject: POC plan & risk tracker - next steps and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@fintec.com>, Priya Shah <priya@fintec.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: POC plan & success criteria (next steps)

Hi Alex / Priya -

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Per our conversation, I've pulled together a first-pass POC plan and a short risk tracker so we can move quickly and surface any blockers early. I've attached the PDF and a simple tracker (also linked). High level summary below.

POC objective:
- Validate Redwood can serve Fintec's fraud-detection prompts at <200ms 95th percentile for typical session lengths, with embeddings for similarity search integrated into your existing stack.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 200ms for 512-token budget on a 1k req/min traffic profile.
2) Accuracy: Key prompt set must achieve >= 92% parity vs. your current baseline on the 200-sample eval set (we'll run these together).
3) Stability: No more than 1 outage >5 minutes during the 2-week window.
4) Integration: Embedding calls integrated and returning expected vectors for 95% of test inputs.

Timeline & ownership:
- Week 0 (next 48-72h): Exchange test data slice + SOC2 summary. (Owner: Fintec / Priya)
- Week 1: Config + initial runs, baseline comparison. (Owner: Redwood / Connor)
- Week 2: Iterate + ramp to target load, run evals, finalize sign-off. (Owners: Marissa / Rishi)

Risk / mitigation (high level):
- Data residency concerns: We can run Private (VPC) pilot or sign an interim data handling addendum; engineering to confirm encryption-in-flight & at-rest.
- Integration gaps (embeddings format): We'll share a shim and sample payloads; Connor will own SDKs.
- Performance regression: Redwood will provide a fallback policy to lower-cost model variants for resilience; we'll track metrics in the risk tracker.

Next steps (please reply to confirm):
1) Priya: share the 200-sample eval set and one week of representative traffic (anonymized) by end of day Friday.
2) Alex: confirm whether a Private/VPC pilot is required for the POC (yes/no).
3) Connor / Rishi / Marissa: we'll set up a 30-min kickoff once we get the data.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf, poc-risk-tracker.xlsx, soc2-summary.pdf

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC plan & success criteria (next steps)

Thanks Marissa - this looks good. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) Hardware: we can provide a small GPU-based sandbox (NVIDIA A10 equivalent) in our test VPC, but for the hosted path we'd want to understand the instance mix you'd recommend.
2) Data residency: Fintec requires logs and PII to remain in our US tenant. We'd prefer a VPC/private pilot if it's not significantly slower to stand up.

We'll aim to get the eval set and a week's anonymized traffic by this Friday (June 13). One more ask: can you include a short list of escalation contacts in case we hit a blocking bug?

- Priya Shah
Head of Integrations, Fintec Solutions
priya@fintec.com

Hi Priya -

Thanks for the quick tempo. Quick answers:
- Hardware: For the latency target we're validating against an m4-like dedicated instance profile (single A10 or equivalent). If you provide the sandbox A10 we'll mirror that for parity testing.
- VPC/private pilot: we can run the POC inside your VPC or set up a customer-dedicated environment in our cloud; Connor will share the infra checklist.
- Escalation: high-level contacts are below. We'll add them to the risk tracker.

Escalation contacts:
- First-line: Connor O'Brien (Engineering lead) - connor@redwood.com - priority response 1 hour
- Second-line: Rishi Malhotra (Solutions/Customer Lead) - rishi@redwood.com - 4 hour response
- Executive escalation: Marissa Cole - marissa@redwood.com - 24 hour response for contractual/SLAs

Connor, can you share the infra checklist and the SDK shim before EOD?

Thanks,
Rishi

Cc: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@fintec.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Blocking issue: embeddings mismatch in production-like run

Team -

We ran the initial integration in our sandbox (A10) this morning. Two issues: 
1) Several embedding vectors are returning NaNs for ~3% of inputs (attached sample).
2) One request caused the service to drop a connection under load (~1:12PM local).

This is blocking our ability to validate accuracy (NaNs corrupt the similarity results). Prioritizing this as a P0. Can you confirm next steps and ETA for mitigation? We're sensitive to doing a VPC-based pilot given compliance windows.

Thanks,
Priya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@fintec.com>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@fintec.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Blocking issue: embeddings mismatch in production-like run

Hi Priya / Alex -

Thank you for raising this. Apologies for the disruption - we treat NaNs and connection drops as P0s. Below is the mitigation and escalation plan: 

Immediate mitigation (engineering):
- Connor to triage the NaN cause (likely input normalization edge-case or quantization artifact); hotfix branch targeted within 6 hours.
- Temporary mitigation: add server-side sanitizer to drop/replace NaN vectors and flag the sample; we'll provide a patch and a small config flip so you can continue the evals in the meantime.

Escalation path: 
- P0 open; Connor (1hr SLA) -> Rishi (4hr SLA) -> Marissa (24hr SLA for contractual escalations).
- If we cannot resolve within 24 hours, Redwood will: provide a daily status update, offer a temporary model-variant fallback that avoids the quantized path, and schedule a joint war-room with Fintec engineering.

Follow-up actions / owners:
- Connor: patch + sanitizer, post fix notes and patch link. (ETA: 6 hours)
- Priya / Fintec: continue to run remaining evals with sanitizer enabled; collect any failing samples. (Owner: Priya)
- Rishi: coordinate SLA and any contractual remediation if duration exceeds thresholds. (Owner: Rishi)
- Marissa: maintain customer communication and exec escalation if needed. (Owner: Marissa)

I've attached a short tracker row to the POC risk tracker and included the escalation contacts in the doc. We're on it and will update you in the next standup.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: bug-screenshot.png, poc-risk-tracker.xlsx
